summary: Macerich filed an 8-K on June 29, 2026, announcing the full exercise of the underwriters' 30-day option to purchase an additional 2,100,000 shares of common stock at $23.12325 per share, under an underwriting agreement dated June 15, 2026. The company entered into additional forward sale agreements with forward purchasers to borrow and sell the option shares. Closing occurred June 26, 2026. Proceeds depend on future physical settlement of the forward agreements, expected by June 16, 2027. The company may elect cash or net share settlement. This is a capital-raising equity forward transaction, not a special situation.
